subject: Observability go-live: pre-launch check-ins and alert routing plan
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability go-live: pre-launch check-ins and alert routing plan

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we move toward your go-live window the week of July 12, I want to lock in two short pre-launch checkpoints we recommended: 1) instrumentation & tracing hooks validation, 2) alert-routing matrix and runbook ownership. Goal is to avoid noisy alerts on day one and ensure SLAs for any production regressions.

Attached is a first-pass obs-checklist (obs-checklist-v1.xlsx) and a quick dashboard wireframe for the customer-facing production view. Can your SREs confirm the following by end of day Friday?
- a short list of staging -> prod differences in service names / span prefixes
- pager on-call rotation and escalation for P0/P1
- any required IP allowlists for tracing/ingest endpoints

Proposed schedule:
- Thu 7/1 10:00–11:00 PT: Instrumentation sanity check (joint session)
- Mon 7/5 14:00–15:00 PT: Alert routing & runbook owners (we'll bring a runbook-template)

Marissa will run the coordination on our side; she’s CC'd. If that schedule works I’ll send invites and a short agenda.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia —

This looks good, thank you. Quick notes from the SRE side:
- We have a few service name suffixes in staging that won't exist in prod (svc-test-*), we will provide an exact mapping by EOD Friday.
- Our on-call rotation is two teams (east/west). For P0 we escalate to on-call then to me. For P1 we page on-call then Slack channel #aurora-incidents.
- IP allowlist for ingest: we may need to request static egress from our VPC; I’ll check with infra.

Rajiv (SRE) — can you confirm whether you need the tracing-hook examples (header names, span ids) or will you use the OpenTelemetry collector config we shared?

Megan (PM) — flagged the dates; Thu 7/1 looks OK for the instrumentation session.

Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform, Aurora Health

Subject: Re: Observability go-live: pre-launch check-ins and alert routing plan

Elena / Rajiv —

Looping in Ben (SRE engagement lead) and Rishi (Solutions) to ensure we cover the alert thresholds and runbook templates. I updated the checklist with a short 'ownership' column and a proposed escalation ladder — attaching runbook-template.md.

A few notes on our side:
- For the instrumentation session we’ll bring the recommended OTEL headers and a quick curl + span example to validate end-to-end.
- For alerts, we recommend separating user-impacting P1 (errors with >1% user impact) from system P1 (ingest/backpressure) so they map to different paging channels.
- We plan a canary period (48 hours) with a reduced alert set before full production alerting.

Next actions:
1) Rajiv to share service name mapping by EOD Friday (6/30).
2) Ben/Rishi to send the runbook roles template and a proposed paging policy by Mon 7/5.
3) Sofia to send calendar invites for the two sessions and a short agenda.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability go-live: pre-launch check-ins and alert routing plan

Thanks — a couple of technical clarifications from SRE before the instrumentation session:

1) Span prefix differences: we will send a CSV mapping svc-test-* -> svc-*; note that three internal services will also change resource attributes when promoting to prod. Is Redwood's KV cache for prefix-deduping sensitive to resource.attribute changes? If yes, we need guidance on cache warming.

2) Dashboard delta: the staging dashboard uses a derived metric (error_rate_v2) computed from trace sampling; in prod we need that metric to include 100% of errors — can Redwood provide a recommended sampling config for the collector to ensure parity?

3) Alert routing: our Slack channel is set for P1 only; can Redwood support separate webhook endpoints per-priority so we can route P0 to PagerDuty immediately and P1 to Slack?

Happy to paste logs/examples in the instrumentation session.

—Rajiv
Rajiv Kumar
Senior SRE, Aurora Health
